items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every separation axiom for a morphism of algebraic stacks is stable under base change (author lemma at source lines 702-707, label lemma-base-change-separated). The proof (source lines 709-724) rewrites the diagonal of the base change as a base change of the original diagonal and applies the stability under base change of the properties defining the axioms (proof lines 709-723). The rewriting of the diagonal is the substance. H3.
